WITH UserMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        typelabel AS subscription_type,
        seglabel AS demographic_segment,
        ageval AS age,
        gendlbl AS gender,
        occulbl AS occupation,
        testgrp AS ab_test_group,
        (subdays * 0.1) + (ageval * 0.2) + 
        CASE gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.3 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.2 
        END + 
        CASE occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.15 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_subscription_value,
        (ageval * 0.3) + 
        CASE gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.2 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.15 
        END + 
        CASE occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.1 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_demographic_score
    FROM users
),
GroupedMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        subscription_type,
        demographic_segment,
        AVG(user_subscription_value) AS avg_usv,
        AVG(user_demographic_score) AS avg_uds,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count
    FROM UserMetrics
    GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment
)
SELECT 
    subscription_type,
    demographic_segment,
    avg_usv,
    avg_uds,
    string_agg(interests, ', ' ORDER BY interests) AS shared_interests,
    user_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        gm.subscription_type,
        gm.demographic_segment,
        gm.avg_usv,
        gm.avg_uds,
        um.interests,
        gm.user_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gm.subscription_type, gm.demographic_segment ORDER BY gm.user_count DESC) AS row_num
    FROM GroupedMetrics gm
    JOIN UserMetrics um ON gm.subscription_type = um.subscription_type AND gm.demographic_segment = um.demographic_segment
) ranked
WHERE row_num = 1
GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment, avg_usv, avg_uds, user_count
ORDER BY user_count DESC;

WITH UserMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        typelabel AS subscription_type,
        seglabel AS demographic_segment,
        ageval AS age,
        gendlbl AS gender,
        occulbl AS occupation,
        testgrp AS ab_test_group,
        (subdays * 0.1) + (ageval * 0.2) + 
        CASE gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.3 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.2 
        END + 
        CASE occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.15 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_subscription_value,
        (ageval * 0.3) + 
        CASE gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.2 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.15 
        END + 
        CASE occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.1 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_demographic_score
    FROM users
),
GroupedMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        subscription_type,
        demographic_segment,
        AVG(user_subscription_value) AS avg_usv,
        AVG(user_demographic_score) AS avg_uds,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count
    FROM UserMetrics
    GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment
)
SELECT 
    subscription_type,
    demographic_segment,
    avg_usv,
    avg_uds,
    string_agg(interests, ', ' ORDER BY interests) AS shared_interests,
    user_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        gm.subscription_type,
        gm.demographic_segment,
        gm.avg_usv,
        gm.avg_uds,
        um.interests,
        gm.user_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gm.subscription_type, gm.demographic_segment ORDER BY gm.user_count DESC) AS row_num
    FROM GroupedMetrics gm
    JOIN UserMetrics um ON gm.subscription_type = um.subscription_type AND gm.demographic_segment = um.demographic_segment
) ranked
WHERE row_num = 1
GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment, avg_usv, avg_uds, user_count
ORDER BY user_count DESC;
